items.title: OpenAI releases o4-turbo: 2.3x faster than o3, same price
items.summary: OpenAI shipped o4-turbo today. Benchmarks show 2.3x speedup over o3 on HumanEval with unchanged pricing at $3/M input tokens.

items.title: Anthropic launches Agents API with built-in tool-use orchestration
items.summary: Anthropic's new Agents API handles tool-call loops, memory, and step budgeting server-side. No more custom orchestration code.

items.title: Mistral open-weights Mixtral 8x30B under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Mistral released Mixtral 8x30B weights under Apache 2.0. Beats Llama 3.1 405B on MMLU while fitting on a single H100 at 4-bit.

items.title: AI coding assistant startup raises $250M Series B at $3B valuation
items.summary: Series B funding round for another AI coding assistant. No product details beyond 'enterprise focus'.

items.title: Prompt injection is still unsolved — new exploit on GPT-4o's vision input
items.summary: Researchers demonstrate a prompt injection via image metadata that bypasses all current safety fine-tunes in GPT-4o vision.

items.title: Sam Altman and Elon Musk trade barbs on X over open-source AI
items.summary: The CEOs exchanged public posts about whether frontier labs should open-source weights. No new policy or product announcements.

items.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Coder hits 91% on SWE-bench Verified
items.summary: DeepMind's new coder variant of Gemini 2.5 Pro scores 91% on SWE-bench Verified, a 14-point jump over Gemini 2.5 Pro baseline.

items.title: Why AI will change everything in 2026 — an opinion piece
items.summary: Vague manifesto about AI transformation. No numbers, no product, just speculation.
